'''Warp-top''' was a high-tech [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] machine<ref name="GG2" /> played in booths.<ref name="DFRSB" /> Traditional warp-tops were horseshoe-shaped, and they were one of the favored games of the hard-core [[crinbid]] fanatics.<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref> [[Gambler/Legends|Gamblers]] could indulge in warp-top at the [[Ace of Sabres]] on [[Kluistar]].<ref name="WHSV" /> onboard the ''[[Coral Vanda]]'' in [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin's]] [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]],<ref name="DFRSB" /> and in the [[Royal Casino/Legends|Royal Casino]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="GG2" />
